# Soumi Ganguly: full site summary

Soumi Ganguly is a freelance technical content writer, data and AI professional and web and digital solutions specialist based in Howrah, West Bengal, India, with 4+ years of experience. She works remotely with clients in India and abroad in English, Bengali and Hindi. Phone: +91 94773 04172. Website: https://soumiganguly.com/ (last updated 8 October 2026)

A: I am Soumi Ganguly, a technical content writer with more than four years of experience. I write research-based technology articles, AI and data science explainers, technical documentation, SEO content and analytical reports. Each brief is shaped around its audience and purpose.

Q: Is Soumi Ganguly available as a freelance technical writer for international clients?
A: Yes. Soumi works remotely with clients in India and abroad, mainly in English, with Bengali and Hindi also available. Share your brief, audience and deadline through the contact page.

Q: What is the difference between technical content writing and general content writing?
A: Technical content writing explains specialised subjects such as software, data, engineering or research accurately for a defined audience, so it needs subject research and precise terminology. General content writing covers broader topics for a wide readership.

Q: What technical writing deliverables can I ask for?
A: Technical articles and blog posts, documentation, research reports, SEO content and academic writing support. The exact deliverables, length and review rounds are agreed before work begins.

Q: Which tools does Soumi use for data analysis?
A: Python, R, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, IBM SPSS and Excel, chosen to suit your data, your audience and the reporting tools you already use.

## Technical writing
URL: https://soumiganguly.com/writing/
Hire a freelance technical writer in India for documentation, technical articles, research reports and SEO content. Remote clients in India, the UK and the USA.

Q: What does a freelance technical content writer do?
A: A technical content writer turns complex subjects such as software, AI, data science and research into clear articles, documentation and reports. Soumi Ganguly offers research-led technical articles, SEO content, technical documentation, business and research reports and academic writing guidance for clients in India, the UK, the USA and beyond.

Q: Who can hire Soumi Ganguly for technical content writing?
A: Businesses, software teams, publishers, researchers and professionals can hire Soumi Ganguly for technical content writing. She is based in India, has 4+ years of technical content writing experience and welcomes remote briefs from India, the UK, the USA and other international markets.

Q: What does your technical writing service include?
A: Services include research-based technology articles, AI and data science explainers, technical documentation, requirements specifications, SEO website content, research reports and presentations. Scope and review stages are agreed for each brief.

Q: Do you offer academic writing and assignment support?
A: Yes. Support includes assignment planning, outlines, draft feedback, editing, referencing guidance, literature review organisation and explanation of research methods. The work helps you develop your own draft and follow your institution’s academic requirements.

Q: Can you connect research writing with data analysis?
A: Yes. Depending on the brief, I can support Python, R, IBM SPSS, Excel, Power BI or Tableau analysis and help explain the methodology, visualisations, findings and limitations in a structured report.

Q: Where can I view your writing samples?
A: Full research reports and presentations appear in the Writing Samples section on this page. The separate Articles & Publications page links to published articles and their original sources.

Q: How do I request a writing project from India or abroad?
A: Use the writing enquiry button or contact form. Include your subject, audience, deliverables, required format or word count, available material, referencing style if relevant, deadline and time zone. I review the brief before we agree scope and next steps.

Q: How much does a freelance technical writer cost?
A: Cost depends on the scope: subject complexity, length, depth of research, number of revisions and deadline. Share your brief on the contact page and the scope and quote can be discussed before work begins.

Q: What is technical documentation?
A: Technical documentation explains how a product, system or process works or how to use it. Examples include user guides, how-to articles, process documentation and reference material.

Q: Can you write SEO-friendly technical blog posts?
A: Yes. Articles can be structured around search intent, clear headings and accurate terminology so that they are useful to readers and easy for search engines to understand.

Q: What do you need from me to start a technical writing project?
A: Send the audience, purpose, subject matter, any source material, preferred tone, length and deadline. A clearer brief means fewer revisions.

## Data analytics and AI
URL: https://soumiganguly.com/data-ai/
Freelance data analyst for dashboards, forecasting and machine learning with Python, R, SQL, Power BI, Tableau and SPSS. Clients in India, the UK, the USA and worldwide.

Q: What does a data analytics and AI service include?
A: Data analytics turns raw data into evidence you can act on. Soumi Ganguly supports data cleaning, exploratory analysis, statistical modelling, forecasting and visual reporting, with machine learning and computer vision project experience, using Python, R, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, IBM SPSS and Excel.

Q: Which data analysis and research tasks can you support?
A: I support data cleaning, exploratory analysis, survey statistics, forecasting, data visualisation, dashboard development and applied machine learning. The method is chosen around the research question, dataset and reporting requirements.

Q: Which software do you use for analytics?
A: My toolkit includes Python, R, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, IBM SPSS and Excel. Depending on the brief, I use Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib or ggplot2 for preparation, modelling and visualisation.

Q: What evidence of your data and AI work is available?
A: My project portfolio includes computer vision, anomaly detection, time-series forecasting and business dashboards. Public GitHub repositories provide source code and documentation where available.

Q: What is the difference between data analytics and machine learning?
A: Data analytics examines existing data to describe what happened and why, usually through summaries, charts and statistical tests. Machine learning builds models that learn patterns from data to predict or classify new cases.

Q: Which tools do you use for dashboards?
A: Power BI and Tableau are used for interactive dashboards, with Excel, SQL, Python or R used to prepare and analyse the data behind them.

Q: Can you help a small business with data analysis?
A: Yes. Sales, customer or operations data can be turned into clear reports and dashboards that show trends and support decisions. Start by describing the question you want answered.

Q: How should I handle sensitive data?
A: Discuss data sensitivity before sharing anything. Where possible, send anonymised data and agree how files will be shared and handled before analysis begins.

Hands-on experience includes a PHP, SQL and HTML/CSS Virtual Learning Environment with role-based access controls and input sanitisation.

A: I offer responsive professional portfolios, business websites, web applications and customised CRM interfaces. Features, backend requirements and handover materials are agreed before implementation.

Q: Can a website include a dashboard or customer workflow?
A: Yes. A scoped web application can include dashboards, customer records, role-based interfaces and agreed workflow features. The design follows the people using the system and the information they need.

Q: Where can I review your development experience?
A: The Projects page includes public repositories and selected work from my CV. My Virtual Learning Environment project used PHP, SQL and HTML/CSS at UR Technology and Computers.

Q: What does a freelance web developer do?
A: A freelance web developer plans, builds and maintains websites and web applications, from the pages visitors see to the server-side logic and database behind them.

Q: Will my website work well on mobile phones?
A: Yes. Sites are built with responsive layouts and reviewed across screen sizes, so pages adapt from small phones to large desktop monitors.

Q: What is the difference between a website and a web application?
A: A website mainly presents information. A web application lets users do things, such as sign in, submit forms or manage records, so it needs server-side logic, a database and access controls.

Q: Can you build a site with a contact form or user login?
A: Yes. Forms and login features can be built with input sanitisation and role-based access controls, so different users see only what they should.

## Custom CRM
URL: https://soumiganguly.com/crm/
Customised CRM development: customer records, lead pipelines, follow-up tasks and reporting mapped to your workflow, with documentation and handover.

Q: What is a customised CRM?
A: A customised CRM is a customer-management system shaped around how your team actually works: customer records, lead pipelines, follow-up tasks and reporting in one workflow. Requirements, user roles and essential features are mapped before implementation, and you receive documentation and a practical handover.

Q: What can a customised CRM include?
A: A customised CRM can include customer records, lead pipelines, tasks, follow-up workflows, role-based dashboards and reporting views. The agreed scope reflects your business process and existing systems.

Q: How is the CRM scope agreed?
A: We first map the workflow, user roles and information requirements. The brief defines the features, technical responsibilities, review criteria and documentation before development begins.

Q: Can CRM development connect with website development?
A: Yes. CRM requirements can be discussed alongside a website or web application brief, with interfaces and data flows planned around the agreed business workflow.

Q: What is a custom CRM?
A: A custom CRM is customer relationship management software built around how your team actually works, tracking customer records, leads, follow-up tasks and reports in one place instead of forcing your process into a generic tool.

Q: Do I need a CRM or is a spreadsheet enough?
A: A spreadsheet is enough while one or two people track a few contacts. A CRM becomes useful when several people need shared records, follow-up reminders, permissions and reports.

Q: What can a custom CRM track?
A: Typical items are customer details, enquiry sources, lead stages, follow-up tasks, notes and sales or service reports. The fields and stages are defined from your workflow map.

Tools discussed include Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite and WordPress.

Q: Which digital marketing services do you offer?
A: I offer SEO-focused website copy, content strategy, editorial planning, articles and digital campaign content support. The brief is shaped around the audience, search intent and business goals.

Q: Which tools are relevant to a digital marketing brief?
A: Depending on the scope and available accounts, digital marketing may use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite and WordPress. Tool selection follows the actual reporting and content requirements.

Q: Can you write technical marketing content?
A: Yes. My technical writing background supports research-led content for software, AI, data and other technology subjects. The content explains the topic clearly while addressing the audience’s questions.

Q: What is SEO content writing?
A: SEO content writing creates pages and articles that answer what people search for, using a clear structure, relevant terms and accurate information so both readers and search engines can understand the page.

Q: How is SEO content different from social media content?
A: SEO content is built to be found through search and stays useful over time. Social content is built for feeds and conversation and is usually shorter-lived. A plan often uses both.

Q: What goes into an editorial plan?
A: An editorial plan lists audience, topics, search intent, formats, publishing dates and review steps, so content is produced consistently instead of ad hoc.

## Social media branding
URL: https://soumiganguly.com/social-branding/
Brand voice, content pillars, post copy and creative direction for a consistent social presence. For entrepreneurs and businesses in India and abroad.

Q: What is social media branding?
A: Social media branding gives a business a consistent voice across its channels: profile copy, content pillars, captions, post planning and creative direction. Deliverables include a brand messaging guide, content pillars and calendar, post copy and social profile content.

Q: What does your social media branding service include?
A: Social media branding includes brand voice, profile copy, content pillars, post planning, captions and guidance on visual consistency. Deliverables are agreed around the platforms, audience and communication goals.

Q: Which tools support social content planning?
A: Canva can support creative production, Meta Business Suite can support Meta platform publishing, and Buffer can support scheduling. The agreed workflow determines which tools and accounts are needed.

Q: Can social branding align with my website content?
A: Yes. Brand messaging, website copy and social content can follow the same voice and content direction, helping people recognise your business across its digital channels.

Q: What is a content pillar?
A: A content pillar is a core theme your brand returns to regularly, such as education, behind-the-scenes or customer stories. Pillars keep posts consistent and make planning easier.

Q: How often should a small business post on social media?
A: It depends on your capacity. Consistency matters more than volume, so the plan should be manageable enough to keep up, with a schedule agreed around your platforms and audience.

Q: What is a brand voice?
A: Brand voice is the personality and tone of your messages, for example warm, expert or playful. A defined voice makes posts, captions and replies feel like they come from the same brand.

## Academic research support
URL: https://soumiganguly.com/academic-research-support/
Assignment planning, feedback on your own draft, editing and Harvard/APA referencing support for students in India, the UK, the USA and worldwide.

Q: What is academic research support?
A: Academic research support is guidance that helps you understand an assignment brief, plan a research approach, organise evidence and improve your own writing and referencing. It supports your work rather than replacing it: You remain responsible for authorship and submission, and for following your institution’s academic-integrity rules.

Q: Can you help with my assignment?
A: Yes. Share the brief and your current work to discuss planning, feedback, editing, referencing or analytical guidance. You remain responsible for authorship and submission, and for following your institution’s academic-integrity rules.

Q: Do you support international students?
A: Remote enquiries are welcome from students in India, the UK, the USA and other countries. Include your university requirements, time zone and deadline.

Q: Which referencing styles can you help with?
A: Harvard and APA referencing are covered, including checking in-text citations and reference lists against the style your university requires.

Q: Is this the same as having my assignment written for me?
A: No. Support is guidance, feedback and editing on your own work. You remain responsible for authorship and for following your institution’s academic-integrity policy.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Use the contact page or email contact@soumiganguly.com with your topic, brief, draft and deadline.

Q: Can you help me plan a research question?
A: Yes. You can discuss narrowing a topic into a focused, answerable research question and choosing evidence that fits it.

## Dissertation and thesis support
URL: https://soumiganguly.com/dissertation-thesis-support/
Dissertation and thesis research help: topic, literature review, methodology, results interpretation and editing guidance for students in India and worldwide.

Q: What is dissertation and thesis research support?
A: Dissertation and thesis support is stage-by-stage guidance on a long research project: refining the topic, aligning aims and objectives, structuring the literature review, explaining the methodology, interpreting results and editing. It supports your own research and writing. You remain responsible for authorship and submission, and for following your institution’s academic-integrity rules.

Q: What should I send for a dissertation enquiry?
A: Send your research topic, programme level, brief, supervisor feedback, completed chapters, referencing style and deadline. Include the dataset or questionnaire if analysis is required.

Q: Can you support a thesis already in progress?
A: Yes. State the specific chapter or problem you need help with so the scope can be discussed before work begins.

Q: Do you write the dissertation for me?
A: No. Support is guidance, feedback and editing on your own research. You remain responsible for authorship and submission, and for following your institution’s academic-integrity rules.

Q: Can you help with methodology and survey design?
A: Yes. Methodology guidance covers choosing between qualitative and quantitative approaches and designing surveys so the method fits your research question.

Q: Can you help interpret my results?
A: Yes. You can discuss how to read your findings and explain them in the discussion chapter. For statistical analysis see research data analysis support.

Q: Can you help with the literature review?
A: Yes. Guidance covers searching for sources, organising them by theme and writing a critical synthesis in your own words rather than a list of summaries.

## SPSS, R and Python research analysis
URL: https://soumiganguly.com/student-data-analysis/
SPSS, R and Python data analysis help for dissertations and research: data cleaning, t-tests, chi-square, regression and plain-language interpretation of output.

Q: What is SPSS, R and Python research analysis support?
A: It is help with analysing research data: checking a dataset, running statistical methods that suit your research question in SPSS, R or Python, presenting the results in readable tables and charts, and explaining what the output means. Methods follow your data and assumptions; significant results cannot be promised.

Q: Which tools can I discuss?
A: SPSS, R, Python, Excel, Tableau and Power BI are included in the portfolio. Share your required software and method when contacting Soumi.

Q: Can you guarantee statistically significant findings?
A: No. Findings depend on the data and appropriate analysis. Support focuses on accurate methods, transparent reporting and defensible interpretation.

Q: What data format should I send?
A: Send the dataset in the format you have, for example an Excel or CSV file or an SPSS file, along with a short description of each variable.

Q: Will you explain the results to me?
A: Yes. Interpretation of SPSS, R or Python output is part of the support, so you can explain the findings in your own report.

Q: I only need charts. Is that possible?
A: Yes. You can ask for readable research visualisations on their own. Share the data and the message each chart should carry.

Q: Do you offer SPSS help for dissertation data analysis?
A: Yes. SPSS support covers checking your dataset, choosing methods that suit the research question, running the tests and explaining the output so you can report the results yourself.

Q: Which statistical tests can you guide me on?
A: Common tests include t-tests, chi-square tests, correlation, regression and reliability analysis, alongside descriptive statistics and visualisation. The right test depends on your variables and assumptions.
